But I'm sure the building is locked.''"<br />"''Thank you.|The woman and Kenobi|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]]</ref>}}
An old '''woman''' lived in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. The [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned [[Gender/Legends|woman]] had a home near the [[Theed Royal Palace/Legends|Theed Royal Palace]]. She lived in Theed during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)}}
During the [[Capture of Theed/Legends|opening stages of the invasion]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] accidentally burst into her home. He reassured her that he was there to help, and asked how to get past the [[Blast door/Legends|blast door]]. The woman told him that the controls were across the street, and Kenobi was able to unlock the door and continue his mission.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|You should really lock your doors.''"<br />"''You shold really mind your own business. Please, get out of my home!|An alternate dialogue choice|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)" />}}
The woman appears in the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]], the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] adaptation of the [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Episode I'']] movie. The player, taking the role of Kenobi, may meet this woman during the course of the game's fifth mission. The player can talk to the woman using several dialogue options and can choose to either tell her to lock her doors or ask for information. If the player chooses the latter option, the woman describes how to get past the locked security door. [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|The game's strategy guide]] explains how to complete this side-quest. She is voiced by [[Mary Kay Bergman]] and is given the name "old Naboo woman" in the game's credits.

The textures for her model were taken from promotional photos of [[Sei Taria]].
